sheets.title: The owner's first catalog frame is lost — joiner, 390
sheets.caption: Same induced loss on both builds: the owner's browser drops its first catalog frame, as Chromium can when a frame is sent the instant the data channel appears. Main never sends it again; this branch's joiner greets, and the owner answers with the catalog.
sheets.before: joiner after 15 s: “Connecting to the owner's browser” · owner: “In the session”

sheets.title: No catalog ever arrives — joiner after 66 s, 390
sheets.caption: Every catalog frame dropped. Main's connect timeout was cleared when the channel opened, so the wait never ends. This branch keeps it until the catalog arrives, closes the attempt, and offers a fresh request.
sheets.before: after 66 s: “Connecting to the owner's browser”, no way on
sheets.after: after 60 s: “Connection timed out” + “Ask to join again”
